chunks: Their excuses will be of no avail to the sinners on that day, and they will not be allowed to beg for favour.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)
key_terms.يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ: They will be allowed to beg for favour / seek pardon

ai.seo_question: What happens to the excuses of the wrongdoers on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine justice, where the 'wrongdoers' (al-Zalimun) are those who actively oppressed themselves through denial and arrogance, rendering their excuses void. The term 'yustatabun' implies a chance for reconsideration or return, which is lost at this stage, highlighting the transition from the realm of choice to the realm of consequence. This moment marks the closure of the door of repentance, a key concept in understanding the eschatological timeline in Shia theology.
